title: How Will the War in Iran End? Our Panel of Experts Answers Your Biggest Questions
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
There are a lot of contradictory statements around the US-Israeli [war on
Iran](https://zeteo.com/p/new-poll-most-americans-believe-
trump?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web):
[Trump](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-war-grand-theft-auto-
memes?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web) claims it's a success, but
billions of dollars later, Iranians still have a Khamenei as their supreme
leader and show no signs of ratcheting down their retaliation against US
interests across the region. [Israel](https://zeteo.com/p/netanyahu-trump-
iran-war-israel?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web) claims it
significantly weakened Iran's [attack capabilities](https://zeteo.com/p/no-
intel-imminent-attack?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web), but Iran
says it hasn't even begun to use their more advanced arsenal. How can you tell
the lie from the truth? By listening to a panel of experts that you will only
find here at **Zeteo.**

[ Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**Mehdi** gathers an A-team of renowned experts to speak on the developments
in the Middle East for a **Zeteo Town Hall** with _paid_ subscribers: **Jeremy
Scahill,** co-founder of [Drop Site News](https://zeteo.com/p/new-poll-most-
americans-believe-trump?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web), which has
been reporting on Iran from the ground. **[Vali
Nasr](https://zeteo.com/p/vali-nasr-iran-protests?utm_source=publication-
search),** Iranian-American professor, acclaimed author, and former US State
Department advisor. And **Rula Jebreal** , an award-winning Palestinian-
Italian journalist, foreign policy analyst, and **Zeteo** contributor. When
three minds of this caliber come on together, the conversation tends to cover
a lot:

  * Nasr discusses the new generation leading Iran, anger from Muslims across the region reevaluating their relationship with the US, and who this war is [actually being waged on](https://zeteo.com/p/ali-vaez-trump-iran?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web), saying that after Iran's leader was assassinated, **" it's not the regime that is under threat… It is Iran."**

  * Scahill describes the **" utter bloodbath"** that would follow a possible [ground invasion](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-ground-invasion-plans-forever-war?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web) of Iran, the real damage from Iranian strikes that the US and Israel are trying to hide, and the potential for a [nuclear war](https://zeteo.com/p/iran-nuclear-weapons-fake-israel-trump-war-iaea-iraq?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web), which he tells Mehdi is **" shocking to the soul." **He also discusses media censorship in Israel and across the Gulf countries and how we aren't getting the full picture of the damage caused by Iran's strikes. 

  * Jebreal highlights the hypocrisy on steroids in launching a new war in the Gulf that will make the Iraq war **" look like a walk in the park." **She discusses the [religious drivers](https://zeteo.com/p/holy-war-against-iran-graham-hegseth-christian-nationalism?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web) behind US and Israeli politicians, the possibility of retaliation on American soil, and how Gulf states are reacting to Trump's actions.

discussed how this war could end and the long-term consequences of what's
unfolded over the past 13 days. **It 's an in-depth conversation you won't
